annotations.title: Other capacities, colours and sizes of a product

description: The variants of one product, each with a stable `id` (its product slug), `current` (true for the one asked for, always listed), storage, size, colour and `color_id`, its lowest total for `deliver_to_country` and stock. `family_id` names the set (a garment's item group, or the model line `line:<words>`), `axes` says what tells them apart. Use it to switch from a card to the exact variant the buyer asked for, then get_product with that id. A product without siblings answers itself only. Mirrors GET /api/v1/deals/products/{slug}/variants.

deliver_to_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
